verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a hosted model API platform like Replicate, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The only related item describes built-in performance metrics and logs, which is an adjacent observability feature rather than a privacy control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
